evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce HealBench, a fine-grained benchmark of 30,000 high-quality image-text pairs spanning 19 categories and 92 subcategories, selected from 100,000 candidates through a human- and expert-in-the-loop pipeline combining vision-language model matching, human preference models, expert filtering, and exemplar-guided augmentation.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Using HealBench-Eval, we conduct objective and subjective evaluations of 14 representative image generation models and prompt-rewriting strategies.

evidence.excerpt: We also construct HealBench-Eval, a feature-clustered evaluation set of 1,095 instances.
